outcome: HIV status of children at 6 weeks post-delivery
Macroscopic/microscopic features of SJS/TEN in placentae and foetus
cohort: Twenty-two consecutive HIV-infected pregnant women admitted to a single tertiary referral centre in South Africa over a 3-year period, all of whom developed SJS/TEN.
finding: In HIV-infected pregnant women with SJS/TEN, the severe form (TEN) was associated with poorer foetal outcomes, but maternal SJS/TEN did not increase maternal mortality and did not commonly manifest in the foetus.
followup_time: 6 weeks post-delivery (for HIV testing in children)
